package nats

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"sync"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// EventPublisher publishes durable student answer lifecycle events to JetStream.
type EventPublisher struct {
	Conn *natsgo.Conn

	mu sync.Mutex
	js natsgo.JetStreamContext
}

// Publish marshals payload and sends it to JetStream.
func (p *EventPublisher) Publish(subject string, payload any) error {
	if p == nil || p.Conn == nil {
		return nil
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	js, err := p.jetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = js.Publish(subject, body)
	return err
}

func (p *EventPublisher) jetStream() (natsgo.JetStreamContext, error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	if p.js != nil {
		return p.js, nil
	}
	js, err := p.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	p.js = js
	return p.js, nil
}

// CommandPublisher publishes internal work-queue commands over plain Core NATS.
type CommandPublisher struct {
	Conn *natsgo.Conn
}

// Publish marshals payload and sends it over Core NATS queue semantics.
func (p *CommandPublisher) Publish(subject string, payload any) error {
	if p == nil || p.Conn == nil {
		return nil
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return p.Conn.Publish(subject, body)
}

var _ domain.EventPublisher = (*EventPublisher)(nil)
var _ domain.CommandPublisher = (*CommandPublisher)(nil)
